rules.name: Work summaries
rules.instruction: When the allowed owner expresses a concrete need to summarize a specified discussion or supplied documents, prepare a source-backed draft for the stated period. The source scope and desired deliverable must be established. Do not edit source documents or publish to a new audience. Accept silently: omit acknowledgement, keep preparation internal, and deliver only a usable result or a necessary decision.

rules.name: Data aggregation
rules.instruction: When the allowed owner requests a specific aggregation of supplied data with an established period and statistical definition, compute a reproducible result and preserve the inputs. Missing critical definitions mean observe only. Do not alter source business records or widen the data scope. Accept silently: omit acknowledgement and keep progress internal.

rules.name: Information research
rules.instruction: When the allowed owner expresses a concrete research need with an established question and source scope, prepare a concise cited answer using the authorized inputs and, when requested, public primary sources. Separate facts from analysis and identify inaccessible evidence. Do not contact others or publish elsewhere. Accept silently: omit acknowledgement and keep progress internal.
